title: Why is my payment still pending?
summary: Explains why a payment may remain “pending,” including that standard transfers complete within 12 hours. Lists other causes: recipient has not taken required action, routine security review, or recipient account temporarily can’t accept funds. Advises checking transaction details, confirming recipient account can receive funds, and contacting support if pending beyond 12 hours.
faqs: How long do standard transfers take before a payment is no longer pending?
What does it mean if my payment is pending because the recipient hasn’t taken an action?
Can a payment stay pending due to security or routine review?
Why would the recipient’s account be temporarily unable to accept funds?
What should I do if the payment is still pending after the standard timeframe?
Where can I find the transaction’s current status and any requested actions?
